method: Deterministic screening only; the rules identify review candidates and do not infer causes or forecasts.

qualification_rules.material_movement: The primary measure crossed its fixed editorial threshold.
qualification_rules.broad_local_shift: At least 65% of covered local markets moved in one direction and the median change reached half of its editorial threshold.
qualification_rules.direction_change: The year-over-year comparison changed sign, with the current and preceding changes each reaching at least half of the editorial threshold.
qualification_rules.indicator_divergence: Two pre-specified related indicators moved in meaningfully different directions or separated by a pre-specified gap.

sections.question: Is residential permitting increasing?
sections.answer: Yes. Los Angeles metro YTD permits rose 42.8%.
evidence: Los Angeles metro: 21,092 units authorized YTD vs. 14,775 in the same months last year.
sections.sources: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey
sections.coverage: Matched permit jurisdictions in Los Angeles and Orange counties; sum of county counts, not an official BPS metro series
sections.caveat: Current-year observations are preliminary and may be revised or imputed; permits are authorizations, not starts or completions.

qualifications.label: Material movement
qualifications.explanation: The primary measure crossed its fixed editorial threshold.

source_releases.provider: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey

sections.question: Are home values keeping pace with local inflation?
sections.answer: No. Los Angeles metro home values changed +0.9% from one year earlier, while LA-area CPI-U changed +3.4% over the same period. The implied inflation-adjusted change was -2.4%.
evidence: Nominal ZHVI changed +0.9% while LA-area CPI-U changed +3.4%.
sections.sources: Zillow Research + U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
sections.coverage: Common-month Zillow ZHVI and LA-area CPI-U
sections.caveat: Real change is a purchasing-power comparison, not an affordability measure. Not seasonally adjusted; the area index covers Los Angeles and Orange Counties.

qualifications.label: Material movement
qualifications.explanation: The primary measure crossed its fixed editorial threshold.

sections.question: Are homes moving faster or slower across Orange County?
sections.answer: Orange County median days on market decreased by 4.0 days; 32 of 41 covered local markets decreased.
evidence: Orange County: The median local change was -4.0 days; among 41 markets with calculable changes, 8 increased, 32 decreased, and 1 was unchanged.
sections.coverage: 41 of 42 local markets had calculable year-over-year changes
sections.caveat: Unweighted median across covered cities using Redfin rolling three-month estimates; it is not a county aggregate.

qualifications.label: Broad local shift
qualifications.explanation: 32 of 41 covered local markets decreased; the median change also reached at least half of its editorial threshold.
